name: Dipipanone
summary: A powerful opioid of equivalent strength to morphine, rarely seen outside of medical environments. Often used to treat severe pain where morphine is contraindicated. Usually found in combination with the antihistamine Cyclizine, which potentiates it.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

uses.text: Dipipanone, sold under the brand names of Pipadone and Diconal is a strong opioid analgesic drug, used for acute pain by mouth (PO) for adults. It is often used in instances where morphine is indicated but cannot be used due to the patient being allergic to morphine.

zhOther: 二苯哌己酮, 雙潘酮
zhHansOther: 二苯呱己酮, 双潘酮

pharmacology.en: Like methadone, it activates the mu-opioid receptor, which relieves pain and causes sedation and euphoria.
pharmacology.zh: 與美沙冬相同，二苯呱己酮會活化μ型鴉片受體，因而能止痛，並帶來鎮靜與欣快感。
pharmacology.zhHans: 与美沙冬相同，二苯呱己酮会活化μ型鸦片受体，因而能止痛，并带来镇静与欣快感。

sideEffects.en: Common effects are drowsiness, nausea, vomiting, constipation and dizziness. It slows breathing, which can be fatal in overdose, and regular use leads to dependence and withdrawal. Injecting crushed Diconal tablets has caused serious damage to veins and limbs.
sideEffects.zh: 常見反應有嗜睡、噁心、嘔吐、便祕與頭暈。它會抑制呼吸，過量時可能致命，長期使用會產生依賴與戒斷症狀。將Diconal錠劑磨碎注射，曾造成血管與四肢的嚴重損傷。
sideEffects.zhHans: 常见反应有嗜睡、恶心、呕吐、便秘与头晕。它会抑制呼吸，过量时可能致命，长期使用会产生依赖与戒断症状。将Diconal锭剂磨碎注射，曾造成血管与四肢的严重损伤。

fact.en: Dipipanone is a close chemical cousin of methadone, with a piperidine ring in place of methadone's dimethylamino group. In the UK, misuse of its combination tablet Diconal led to rules requiring a special Home Office licence to prescribe it for addiction.
fact.zh: 二苯呱己酮是美沙冬的化學近親，以哌啶環取代了美沙冬的二甲胺基。在英國，其複方錠劑Diconal曾遭濫用，因此醫師須持有內政部的特別許可，才能開立此藥治療成癮。
fact.zhHans: 二苯呱己酮是美沙冬的化学近亲，以哌啶环取代了美沙冬的二甲胺基。在英国，其复方锭剂Diconal曾遭滥用，因此医师须持有内政部的特别许可，才能开立此药治疗成瘾。
